_关于本文件: 「完整方案」的一句话简介。键为 mooncakes 包名，值为 [中文, 英文]。仅完整方案需要撰写，基础库沿用注册表原描述。修改后运行 python3 pipeline/analyze.py 重新构建；构建日志会列出缺失或对不上的条目。以 _ 开头的键不参与构建，可作注释。
_写法约定: 说明形态与能力，必要时补充适用边界。不使用营销性形容词，不重复注册表已有的描述。中文以 50 字上下为宜，英文不超过 30 词，通篇使用陈述句。
moonbit-community/proton: 基于内置浏览器渲染的桌面运行时，兼容现有前端技术栈，并提供托盘、剪贴板、全局热键等系统模块。
Desktop runtime rendering through a built-in browser, compatible with existing frontend stacks, with tray, clipboard and global hotkey modules.
wzzc-dev/moui: 自带渲染引擎的跨端 GUI 框架，不依赖系统 WebView 与系统渲染，桌面与移动共用一套代码。
Cross-platform GUI framework with a built-in renderer, independent of system WebView and system rendering; one codebase for desktop and mobile.
NoahLiu/native-gui: 原生桌面 GUI 框架，界面由系统渲染引擎绘制，一套代码生成 Windows、Linux、macOS 窗口，内置托盘与通知。
Native desktop GUI framework rendering through the system renderer; one codebase yields native windows on Windows, Linux and macOS, with tray and notifications built in.
vectie/lepusa: MoonBit 原生桌面框架的研究性实现，可作为架构参考。
A research implementation of a MoonBit-native desktop framework, usable as an architectural reference.
Nanaloveyuki/orbit: 组合式桌面应用基座，原生窗口配系统 WebView，IPC 支持策略授权，附 orbit-cli 工具链。
Composable desktop application foundation using native windows and the system WebView, with policy-based IPC authorization and an orbit-cli toolchain.
lepus-apps/webview: 以 Web 技术构建桌面应用的框架，界面层由 HTML/CSS 实现，MoonBit 负责窗口与系统调用。
Desktop application framework built on web technologies: the interface is implemented in HTML/CSS while MoonBit handles windows, events and system calls.
tonyfettes/giraffe: 基于 GTK4 的声明式 UI 框架，采用 Elm 架构，界面由 GTK 原生控件构成。
Declarative UI framework bound to GTK4, using the Elm architecture with native GTK widgets.
XiLaiTL/moobile: Rabbita（TEA）移动端方案，一套代码输出 Android、iOS 与 Web，React Native 渲染。
Mobile solution built on Rabbita (TEA); one codebase targets Android, iOS and Web, rendered by React Native.
lampclaw/minimoon: 面向微信小程序 Skyline 渲染引擎的 UI 运行时，采用 Elm 状态机，局部状态更新具备事务性。
UI runtime for the WeChat MiniApp Skyline renderer, driven by Elm state machines with transactional local state.
Magic486/moon-miniprogram: 微信小程序开发框架，提供类型安全运行时、状态自动 diff、跨页 store 与声明式路由。
WeChat MiniProgram framework with a type-safe runtime, automatic state diffing, cross-page store and declarative routing.
shop1111/moonohos: HarmonyOS 原生模块框架，支持异步任务、平台模块调用与 HAR 打包。
HarmonyOS native module framework supporting async tasks, platform module calls and HAR packaging.
lampclaw/lampo: 面向小程序 Skyline 的 UI 框架，采用纯 Elm 风格，状态按组件隔离，不使用全局 store。
Skyline UI framework with pure Elm-style authoring and component-scoped state instead of a global store.
vectie/bunnia: 小程序 UI 框架，采用 Rabbita 风格，通过可插拔的平台适配层支持多端。
Mini-app UI framework in Rabbita style, reaching multiple hosts through pluggable platform adapters.
moonbit-community/rabbita: 官方函数式 Web UI 框架，采用 Elm 架构（Model-Update-View），生态配套最完整。
Official functional web UI framework using the Elm architecture (Model-Update-View), with the most complete ecosystem.
mizchi/luna: 细粒度响应式 UI 库，基于信号驱动，不使用虚拟 DOM diff，更新粒度与产物体积可控。
Fine-grained reactive UI library built on signals without virtual DOM diffing, giving control over update granularity and bundle size.
marianoguerra/tutuca: 完整 UI 框架，集成模板语言、虚拟 DOM、组件、运行时、lint 与 CLI。
A complete UI framework bundling a template language, virtual DOM, components, runtime, lint and CLI.
Arcelyth/aitne: 轻量响应式 Web 框架，运行时开销低，适用于内容型页面。
Lightweight reactive web framework with low runtime overhead, intended for content-oriented pages.
mizchi/tui: 基于信号驱动的终端 UI 库，状态变更自动重绘，适用于响应式编程风格的项目。
Signal-driven terminal UI library that repaints on state change, suited to reactive programming styles.
moonbit-community/rabbita_tui: 官方终端 UI 工具包，采用 Elm 架构，与 Rabbita 共享同一套组织方式。
Official terminal UI toolkit using the Elm architecture and sharing Rabbita's approach.
Frank-III/onebit-tui: 集成 Yoga flexbox 布局引擎的终端 UI 库，以 CSS 盒模型方式排版。
Terminal UI library with a Yoga flexbox layout engine, laying out interfaces with CSS box model rules.
moonbitstack/moonetui: 功能完备的终端 UI 工具包，含单元格缓冲、差分 ANSI 渲染、增量按键解析、五十个组件与设计系统。
Comprehensive terminal UI toolkit with a cell buffer, differential ANSI rendering, incremental key parsing, fifty widgets and a CSS-like design system.
brickfrog/pippa: 终端 UI 框架，采用 Bubble Tea 风格与 Model-Update-View 模式，消息类型化。
Terminal UI framework in the Bubble Tea style, using Model-Update-View with typed messages.
Yoorkin/ArgParser: 轻量参数解析库，支持命令、选项与子命令定义，无额外依赖。
Lightweight argument parser supporting commands, options and subcommands, with no additional dependencies.
mizchi/admiral: 声明式 CLI 构建器，采用 gunshi 风格，以数据描述命令结构，自动生成帮助文本与补全。
Declarative CLI builder in the gunshi style: the command tree is described as data, with help text and completion generated.
TheWaWaR/clap: Rust clap 的移植版本，接口与用法基本一致，迁移成本低。
A port of Rust's clap with an essentially identical interface, keeping migration cost low.
totto2727/admiral: admiral 的异步优先分支，命令处理可直接返回异步结果。
Async-first fork of admiral, allowing command handlers to return async results directly.
Milky2018/selene: 基于 ECS 架构的游戏引擎，实体、组件与系统分层明确，适用于逻辑复杂且持续扩展的项目。
ECS-based game engine with a clear entity-component-system separation, suited to complex and long-running projects.
mizchi/kagura: 2D 游戏引擎，参照 Ebiten 设计，提供游戏循环与精灵绘制，适用于中小规模项目。
2D game engine modeled on Ebiten, providing a game loop and sprite drawing for small to medium projects.
sssssurf/abyssal_chord: 卡牌对战专用引擎，内置回合、牌库与结算流程，附带命令行示例。
Card battle engine with built-in turn, deck and resolution mechanics, plus a command-line demo.
sacckey/moon8bit: 复古风格 2D 引擎，资源以文本描述，运行时具备确定性，适用于快速迭代与自动化生成。
Retro 2D engine with text-described assets and a deterministic runtime, suited to rapid iteration and automated content generation.
firefly/firefly: Firefly Zero 掌机的游戏 SDK，仅面向该硬件平台，不适用于通用桌面环境。
Game SDK for the Firefly Zero handheld; targets that device only, not general desktop.
sennenki/reisen: 视觉小说引擎，以剧本、立绘与分支组织内容，不适用于通用游戏开发。
Visual novel engine organized around scripts, artwork and branching; not a general game framework.
moonbitlang/moonback: 官方 Web 后端框架，提供路由、中间件与请求响应抽象，是生态项目的常用基础。
Official web backend framework providing routing, middleware and request/response abstractions; a common base for ecosystem projects.
mizchi/mars: Hono 风格 Web 框架，提供 trie 路由、中间件与 SSE，可运行于原生与 Node.js。
Hono-style web framework with trie routing, middleware and SSE, built on mizchi/x HTTP for both native and Node.js.
oboard/mocket: 通用 Web 框架，提供路由与中间件等基础能力。
General web framework providing routing and middleware.
bobzhang/crescent: Web 框架，由 MoonBit 语言作者实现，目前公开文档较少。
A web framework by MoonBit's language author; public documentation is still limited.
jaredzhou/pony: 轻量 HTTP 框架与路由器，采用 Go 的 Chi 风格，适用于仅需路由与中间件的服务。
Lightweight HTTP framework and router in Chi style, for services that only need routing and middleware.
RabitLogic/mbit: Gin 风格 Web 框架，API 设计与 Go 生态一致，迁移成本低。
Gin-style web framework whose API mirrors the Go ecosystem, keeping migration cost low.
moonbitstack/moonapi: 类型化 Web 框架，路由、参数与响应均纳入类型检查，错误在编译期暴露。
Typed web framework that brings routes, parameters and responses under type checking, surfacing errors at compile time.
daqing/moonway: 全栈 Web 框架，前后端在同一工程内组织，无需拆分构建流程。
Full-stack web framework keeping frontend and backend in one project without separate build pipelines.
wflixu/Halo: 基于 Koa 洋葱模型的中间件框架，支持结构化并发与流式响应，适用于中间件层次较多的服务。
Middleware framework based on Koa's onion model, supporting structured concurrency and streaming responses.
kupas/express: Express 兼容的 Web 框架，底层采用 uWebSockets，便于从 Node.js 迁移。
Express-compatible web framework running on uWebSockets, easing migration from Node.js.
KKKIIO/moondark: Django 风格的后端框架，基于 moonback，对工程结构有明确约定。
Django-style backend framework built on moonback with conventions for project structure.
moonbitstack/moonzero: 服务框架，面向服务化场景，与 Web 框架定位不同。
Service framework for service-oriented scenarios, positioned differently from a web framework.
anccnuer/onho: Hono 风格轻量 Web 框架，提供基础的路由与中间件。
Lightweight Hono-style web framework with basic routing and middleware.
moonbitstack/moondb: 数据库访问的标准接口层，定义驱动与查询层之间的契约，本身不实现具体数据库。用于避免上层代码绑定特定数据库。
Standard database access interface defining the contract between drivers and the query layer, without implementing any database; keeps upper layers engine-agnostic.
oboard/morm: 轻量 ORM，提供类型化查询与代码生成，支持多种数据库引擎。
Lightweight ORM with typed queries and code generation across multiple database engines.
moonbitstack/moonorm: ORM 与 SQL 工具包，模型映射与查询构建由同一套接口提供。
ORM and SQL toolkit providing model mapping and query building through one interface.
wflixu/Orion: Derive 与代码生成 ORM，以 Schema DSL 描述表结构，生成类型安全 CRUD 与查询构建器。
Derive-and-codegen ORM: tables are described in a schema DSL, with type-safe CRUD and a query builder generated.
zen314/shadow: 轻量 ORM，接口简单，适用于中小规模项目。
Minimal ORM with a simple interface, suited to small and medium projects.
moonbitlang/async: 官方异步库，提供协程调度与 IO 抽象，是生态中的基础依赖。
Official async library providing coroutine scheduling and IO abstractions; a base dependency across the ecosystem.
peter-jerry-ye/async: 异步库，提供 Promise、事件循环与 IO，接口风格接近 JavaScript。
Async library offering promises, an event loop and IO, with an interface close to JavaScript.
didiLjf/moonorbit: Actor 并发框架，以消息传递代替共享状态，适用于并发写入冲突较多的服务。
Actor concurrency framework replacing shared state with message passing, suited to services with contended writes.
kalculos/miao: 异步 IO 库，默认运行时为 libuv，行为与 Node.js 生态接近。
Async IO library using libuv as its default runtime, behaving similarly to the Node.js ecosystem.
Yu-zh/data: serde 形态的序列化框架，以单一数据模型支持多种格式，切换格式无需重写序列化逻辑。
Serde-shaped serialization framework: one data model serves multiple formats, so switching formats needs no rewrite.
chensuiyi/bm2: 面向 Bun 与 Node.js 应用的 Linux 进程管理器，以 MoonBit 实现。
Linux process manager for Bun and Node.js applications, implemented in MoonBit.
mizchi/actrun: 兼容 GitHub Actions 的本地 CI 运行器，工作流可在本机执行，不依赖远端。
Local CI runner compatible with GitHub Actions, executing workflows on the local machine.
kupas/pm3: 语言无关的进程管理器，参照 PM2 设计，内置日志轮转。
Language-agnostic process manager modeled on PM2, with built-in log rotation.
tiye/redstart: 面向本地开发的轻量进程管理器，支持一组服务的批量启动与停止。
Lightweight process manager for local development, starting and stopping groups of services.
colmugx/posoco: 六边形架构（端口-适配器）Agent 框架，定义扩展端口与 Agent 循环，LLM 与工具可替换。
Agent framework using hexagonal (ports-and-adapters) architecture, defining extension ports and an agent loop with swappable providers and tools.
colmugx/mcp: 类型安全的 MCP SDK，同时提供服务端与客户端，支持 STDIO 与 HTTP 两种传输。
Type-safe MCP SDK providing both server and client over STDIO and HTTP transports.
golemcloud/golem_sdk: Golem 平台的 SDK，用于构建可持久化、可故障恢复的 agent，需绑定该托管平台。
SDK for the Golem platform, used to build durable and fault-tolerant agents at the cost of platform lock-in.
weopqrst/agent: LangChain 核心库的 MoonBit 实现，类型安全、可组合，LLM 客户端基于 mizchi/llm。
MoonBit implementation of LangChain's core: type-safe, composable and embeddable, with LLM clients from mizchi/llm.
soehi/moonlm: 本地 LLM 推理引擎与强类型 agent 运行时，无需外部 API 即可运行模型。
Local LLM inference engine with a strongly typed agent runtime, running models without external APIs.
moonbitlang/yacc: 官方 LR(1) 语法分析器生成器，由文法生成解析器，适用于完整语言语法的实现。
Official LR(1) parser generator producing parsers from grammars, suited to full language syntax.
cogna-dev/parkit: nom 风格的解析器组合子框架，以函数组合构建解析逻辑，适用于局部格式解析。
Nom-style parser combinator framework composing parsing logic from functions, for local formats rather than full languages.
moonbitlang/quickcheck: 官方 QuickCheck 实现，以属性描述行为并自动生成输入查找反例。
Official QuickCheck implementation: behavior is described as properties, with generated inputs searching for counterexamples.
moonrockz/moonspec: BDD 测试框架，支持 Gherkin 语法与 Cucumber 表达式，可按需求描述编写可执行测试。
BDD framework supporting Gherkin syntax and Cucumber expressions, running tests written as requirements.
aspnmy/moonitest: 集成测试框架，通过真实 Docker、TCP 与 HTTP 调用后端接口，作为单元测试的补充。
Integration testing framework invoking real Docker, TCP and HTTP backends as a complement to unit tests.
Duckweed/moon-proof: 文档示例的持续验证框架，抽取文档中的代码块并隔离编译运行，用于确认示例是否仍然有效。
Continuous verification for documentation examples, extracting code blocks and running them in isolation to confirm they still work.
Milky2018/wasmoon: WebAssembly 运行时，内置 JIT 与解释器，支持 WASI 与组件模型。
WebAssembly runtime with built-in JIT and interpreter, supporting WASI and the Component Model; loads and executes wasm modules from MoonBit.
